description: Amalgamation of 59-61 (Sui Generis) and 63 (Class A3/A5) at basement and ground floor levels to provide a single restaurant (Class A3) and/or retail unit (Class A1), together with external refurbishment of the shopfront.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (561-PP-01, 561-PP-02(A), 561-PP-03, 561-PP-04(A), 561-PP-05 and Cover Letter/Statement [received 28/02/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for A1/A3 uses and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for A1/A3 purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 07:00 - 23:00.

Condition : 5 - Prior to first occupation of the unit, a Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. This shall include a restriction that the size of delivery vehicles be no greater than 7.5T and that all servicing must be undertaken from the loading bay west of the site to prevent obstruction of the bus stop adjacent to the proposed development. The Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of the unit, full details (including manufacturers specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout and be fully implemented and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. They shall not be located in the same space as the refuse store.

Condition : 7 - Any kitchen noise and odour extraction/exhaust system installed must be in compliance with the DEFRA guidance for the control of odour and noise from commercial kitchen exhaust systems and flue stacks set no less than one metre above the fa?ade height of the building shall be installed.
